claim_text: UMG Recordings, Capitol Records and Capitol CMG filed suit against DistroKid entities in the District of Delaware on September 15, 2026, docket 1:26-cv-01156.
wording_guardrail: Use final civil docket; stamped complaint has temporary intake header.

claim_text: The complaint asserts Delaware deceptive trade practices and multiple copyright-infringement theories against DistroKid.
wording_guardrail: Always attribute; no liability finding exists.

claim_text: UMG states the lawsuit is not about distribution of AI-generated music when clearly disclosed as such.
wording_guardrail: Do not frame as a ban on all AI music.

claim_text: UMG alleges an account/artist name called Lofi Chill released 4,562 tracks through DistroKid in twelve months.
wording_guardrail: Attribute to complaint; not a finding.

claim_text: The complaint says Exhibits A/B contain 1,000 examples and says plaintiffs identified nearly 2,000 allegedly infringing DistroKid-distributed recordings.
UMG alleges DistroKid received rights-management conflict notices and in some instances continued distribution after acknowledging a rights conflict.

The complaint seeks injunctions plus statutory damages up to the applicable maximum per infringed work or actual damages/profits; it alleges willfulness and requests $150,000 per work where applicable.
wording_guardrail: Not an award and not a fixed total case value.

claim_text: DistroKid publicly says it strongly disagrees with UMG's allegations, takes copyright/fraud prevention seriously and intends to defend its practices vigorously.
DistroKid's current AI-upload policy requires rights ownership and bars unauthorized impersonation, mass-generated spam and infringement.
wording_guardrail: Published policy is not proof of universal compliance.

claim_text: DistroKid currently markets unlimited music uploads to Spotify, Apple Music, TikTok and 150+ platforms.
wording_guardrail: Current site claim; do not infer market share.

claim_text: IFPI launched the Streaming Integrity Initiative on September 14, 2026; UMG is listed among initial supporters and DistroKid is not named in the initial supporter list.
CVC announced July 6, 2026 that it signed a definitive agreement for a majority investment in DistroKid; official terms were not disclosed.
wording_guardrail: Do not turn reported valuation into official price.

claim_text: Current docket feeds show September 28 document 12 reset the answer deadline and set an open/answer/reply/surreply briefing schedule.
wording_guardrail: Exact new dates not exposed; Oct.6 is superseded.

claim_text: As of October 3, no merits ruling or damages award was identified; the accessible current Docket Nexus feed does not identify a defendant responsive pleading after the Sept.28 schedule entry.
